title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 7, section 5 (Bowen Island)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 7 No Hunting Areas (Section 8)
Bowen Island
5 That portion of M.U. 2-16 being Bowen Island, within 150 m of any public highway, school building, school yard, public park, playground, church, workshop, place of business, dwelling house or farm building. [am. B.C. Reg. 459/90, s. 3.]
